test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: U, V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting in a circle, facing the middle of the circle. V is to the left of Y, W is to the right of Y, Z is in the middle of U and X. U is to the immediate right of W. Who is to the immediate left of V?
solution:
Given that: U, V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting in a circle, facing the middle of the circle.

 
• U is to the immediate right of W.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c99a36ac79f36c0b9f751cde68d908fa1e38fc2580bbefea9da0b9debae57ba.png] 

 
• Z is in the middle of U and X.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cfbe0ea5f73cf2a8262f64e606a512384d27563831c6b17513516fec4a6bc4f8.png] 

 
• W is to the right of Y.
 
• V is to the left of Y.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ad7be08d7be8da3d17d047142466190b2c77b6589bcf200bea85ae31f597b16.png] 

 
• X is the immediate left of V.

Hence, **"option 4"** is the correct answer.
